# EPA fluoride regulation fixture

Fixture type: author-created paraphrase for deterministic testing.
Original source: https://www.epa.gov/sdwa/fluoride-drinking-water
Publisher: U.S. Environmental Protection Agency
Observed: 2026-08-02

EPA states that the federal maximum contaminant level for fluoride is 4.0 mg/L.

The agency is conducting an accelerated assessment of newer evidence about
potential health risks. A regulatory ceiling and a public-health fluoridation
target answer different questions and must not be treated as equivalent.
